That was the war aim from the first week and it has been achieved, and there is no version of this morning that feels like the word victory is doing honest work. The ledger is not a thing to be softened here and will not be. The generation that held Verdun and would not attack in 1917 and attacked in 1918 is the generation that is not coming back.Settled recordAugust 1914: the plan was abandoned before it was tried. The Marne: attacked, and contained short of a separation. July 1918: the reserve took the initiative at Villers-Cotterets. Verdun: both banks held, by rotation. The Aisne: halted on the undertaking given. The crisis of 1917: answered with remedy and repression together. March 1918: command was unified under Foch. 1915: offensives in Artois and Champagne. The Somme: committed alongside the British. La Malmaison: stopped on its objective. 1918 command: unified from March.Return to file
